answer.says: Good afternoon. I am here to prepare for my lecture on Tuesday. Do I need a specific pass to enter the reading room, or will the guard suffice for now?
answer.thought: The heat is already pressing, and the air quality suggests the city is choking on its own industry. I have no appetite, having eaten nothing since yesterday, but the body is a vessel that must be maintained for the mind's work. I shall not eat here among strangers; I must first secure the room to review my notes for Tuesday's talk, which is the only thing that matters right now.
